Tehsil – Akbarpur, District - Kanpur Dehat Uttar Pradesh – 209121 Contact Persons: 1. Mr. Punit Kumar Tekriwal Project Leader (E&P) – North Mob. No.: +91 9713092799 E-mail: punitktekriwal@bharatpetroleum.in 2. Ms. Ashish Kumar Site Engineer (E&P) – North Mob. No.: +91 7979852867 E-mail: ashishkumar012@bharatpetroleum.in SCOPE OF WORK The scope of work includes providing liaisoning services towards obtaining factory license approval from di rectorate of factories, consent to operate from state pollution control board, fire license from department o f fire and emergency services, and consultancy services to obtain safety report for BPCL Kanpur LPG plant. 1. OBTAINING FACTORY LICENSE FROM DIRECTORATE OF FACTORIES 1) Preparing and submitting the application in prescribed format with all r equired documents and drawings at the Office at Chief Inspector of Factor ies for construction of LPG Hub and Bottling Plant at Kanpur for final appr oval. 2) To hold technical discussion at the office of Chief Inspector of Factories and submit clarification if any. 3)This approval is to seek final NOC after submitting final detailed drawin g of civil sheds and structure and plan of buildings. Preparation of drawing s as per factories norms is in the scope of vendor. 4) To follow up with Factories Department to get the drawing approvals fo r NOC & Liasioning with Officials to get the NOC shall be in the scope of th

e vendor. 5) Getting stability study and obtaining stability certificate of civil structur es, pressure vessels and pipeline will be under vendor’s scope. NOTE: - ONLY STATUTORY APPLICATION FEE PAYMENTS WILL BE IN THE S COPE OF BPCL. 2. OBTAININIG CONSENT TO OPERATE FROM STATE POLLUTION CONT ROL BOARD Providing liaisoning services towards obtaining Consent to Operate (CTO) for the LPG Hub and Bottling Plant, Kanpur. The scope of work includes vis iting the offices of Uttar Pradesh State Pollution Control Board at Kanpur N agar, Kanpur Dehaat, Lucknow, as applicable for discussions with PCB offi cials, liaisoning, obtaining required application forms, list of required doc uments, preparation of site plan and reports, preparation & arranging all other required documents, arranging various data related to this applicati on, assisting BPCL in submission of online application, following up, replyi ng to queries, arranging document verification, arranging site inspection by PCB officials, carrying out site inspection and all data verification and o btaining Consent to Operate (CTO) from Uttar Pradesh State Pollution Con trol Board. NOTE:- ONLY STATUTORY APPLICATION FEE PAYMENTS WILL BE IN THE S COPE OF BPCL. 3. OBTAINING FIRE LICENSE FROM DEPARTMENT OF FIRE AND EMERG ENCY SERVICES 1) Preparing and submitting the application in prescribed format with all r equired documents and drawings at Fire Office for construction of LPG Hu b and Bottling Plant at Kanpur for final approval. 2) To hold technical discussion at the Fire office and submit clarification if any. 3) To follow up and liaising at Fire office at Kanpur Dehaat and Kanpur Na gar to get NOC from fire department or any other designated officer. 4) Arrangement for their site visit, preparing and submission of required d rawings and documents for approval will be in vendor’s scope. 5) Follow-up and laisioning with the Officials to get the NOC NOTE: - ONLY STATUTORY APPLICATION FEE PAYMENTS WILL BE IN THE S COPE OF BPCL. 4. CONSULTANCY SERVICES TO OBTAIN SAFTEY REPORT To obtain Safety Report under Rule 10 of MSIHC Rule, 1989 from compete nt authority as specified in PESO initial approval of Kanpur LPG Bottling Pl ant. Preparing and submitting the application in prescribed format with all required documents and drawings will be in vendor’s scope.

Completion Time Period: The completion time period for obtaining factory license approval from directorate of factories consent to o perate from state pollution control board, fire license from department of fire and emergency services, and consultancy services to obtain safety report for BPCL Kanpur LPG plant will be 03 calendar months from a ward of the work. SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF TENDER 1. The bidders are requested to read the above scope of work and other documents enclosed with th e tender enquiry before submitting their bids. In case of any clarifications, the above contact perso n/s may be contacted. 2. The bidders are requested to visit BPCL Kanpur LPG Plant before submission of their bid and appri se themselves about the work & site-specific conditions. 3. The successful bidder shall mobilize immediately after the award of the work. Any delay on accou nt of late mobilization will be viewed very seriously, and necessary action will be initiated as per c ontract guidelines. 4. The total completion time period for this work 03 calendar months from the date of award of work . 5. No part payment is allowed. Payment for each item will be released upon the completion of the en tire item to the satisfaction of BPCL. 6. The successful bidder shall visit the terminal immediately after the award of the work and start col lection of the data to submit the application within the shortest possible time period. 7. The successful bidder shall depute skilled & experienced personnel who have handled similar natu re work in the past. MANDATORY CONDITIONS FOR BID ACCEPTANCE 1. The bidder shall along with their bid submit copies of atleast any 02 (Two) l iasioning services as per scope of work. These orders must have been exec uted by the bidder for any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU within th e last 03 calendar years. 2. Average Annual Turnover: The average annual turnover of the Bidder for the last three audited accounting

years should be equal to or more than INR 5.75 lakhs Bidder shall furnish last 03 years Annual Report/ audited balance sheets i ncluding Profit and Loss Accounts along with the Bid to establish Bidder's conformance to Qualification Criteria. 3. The net worth of bidder should be positive in last financial year. 4. The bidder shall upload a copy of this Special Conditions of Tender docume nt duly signed & stamped on all the pages as a token of acceptance of thes e terms & conditions. 5. The bidder shall upload all required documents along with their technical bid thru GeM Portal only . Submission of documents thru any other mode will not be accepted. All replies to the technical q ueries during bid evaluation shall also be submitted thru GeM Portal only. 6. Failure on part of the bidder to comply with any of these mandatory conditions will result in the dis qualification of their technical bid and the price bid of such bidder will not be considered for price e valuation. ************* . 6.
